adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, `update` and `destroy` fetch with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` but do not handle `nil`. `update` then calls `save_host(host)` and `save_host` immediately dereferences (`host.host = ...`), and `destroy` calls `host.destroy`; both will raise `NoMethodError` and yield a 500 for nonexistent IDs. `save_host` also assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` is present and does `params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, which will also raise `NoMethodError` on malformed/missing params. The added controller specs only assert subclassing and do not cover these error paths.
